name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
summary: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is an eccentric dwarven brewer of the Thunderbrew clan, camped out in the Dagger Hills of Westfall. He spends his days concocting potent spirits and speaking almost entirely in verse.

sections.title: A Brewer in Exile
sections.body: Hailing from the renowned Thunderbrew brewing family of Kharanos, Grimbooze left the snowy mountain peaks of Dun Morogh for the windswept hills of Westfall. Known for his jovial disposition and an unyielding passion for potent spirits, he has a peculiar habit of speaking strictly in rhymes, and he answers a traveler's questions only once they have completed a simple task for him. Travelers passing through the dangerous Dagger Hills can find him tending to his private casks, always eager to test a thirsty traveler's palate.

faq.q: Where can I find Grimbooze Thunderbrew?
faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is stationed in the Dagger Hills, situated in southern Westfall, keeping camp amidst the hills with his brewing equipment.

faq.q: Why is Grimbooze speaking in rhymes?
aliases: why is he talking in verse
faq.answer: No one can say for certain. Grimbooze simply delights in verse, and he insists that anyone with a question for him must first complete a simple task.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Thunderbrew Distillery?
faq.answer: Grimbooze is a member of the famous Thunderbrew clan of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. While kin like Ragnar Thunderbrew tend the family's distillery at home, Grimbooze brews on his own in the hills of Westfall.

angles.text: Every dwarf knows the Thunderbrew name, and finding one of their foremost elders brewing wild recipes in the Westfall hills is a welcome taste of Dun Morogh.
Culinary adventurers and spirit crafters revere the Thunderbrew legacy, making an encounter with Grimbooze a lesson in artisanal brewing.
